author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Deploy verified public IP HTTPS for health-only bootstrap
details: Add a standalone pinned Caddy proxy with Let's Encrypt short-lived public IP certificates, persistent renewal storage, strict non-secret configuration validation and a verified-TLS probe. Only GET health/readiness reach the existing private backend; all API, enrollment, upload and WebSocket routes remain 503 pending accepted integration. Preserve existing backend readiness and private ports; no domain or new server purchase.
validation: Laptop and server verified HTTPS health 200, readiness/API 503 and IP certificate trust. Proxy restart preserved the certificate fingerprint and passed probes. After accepted CS-031 integration, Linux: 74 backend tests, 72 passed and 2 optional image tests skipped, including real Caddy routing/TLS; 39 shared tests and replay smoke passed. Full authenticated backend, real Pi upload, model readiness and laptop fallback remain unaccepted.
